name: scout
description: Research any company with no API keys: facts, tech stack, hiring, GitHub activity and red flags.

notes_directory.title: Notes folder
notes_directory.description: Where your research notebook and cache are stored. Leave blank for ~/.scout, the same notebook the Claude Desktop extension uses.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Not needed. A fine-grained token with read-only access to public repositories raises GitHub's search limit from 10 to 30 a minute, for researching many companies at once.
